answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Lunartracker moon proof attested before the ephemeris ledger — 3-year night-watch service, 85 supervised sightings, theory exam, annual ledger fees. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 654 pays 9156 minutes every single epoch. The quartz names the issuer, the echo names the price, and the orchard names the date: a forger must forge all three. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
